title: Claude Code plugin theme
description: A theme file of a plugin's themes/ (or experimental.themes) as Claude Code 2.1.330 reads it (Agent Plugins Extended 1.1.0, section 6.2.1). Its slug is the file name without .json.
$comment: Claude Code never fails a plugin for a theme: an unknown token and an invalid colour are ignored, an unknown base reads as dark, a name that is not a non-empty string reads as the slug, and a file that is not an object is not listed (section 6.2.1 items 2 and 3, Judgment J6.9). So the root accepts any JSON value, and $defs/effective states the values that take effect.

overrides.description: Colour token name to colour; the tokens are listed in section 6.2.1 item 4.
